item: A non-finite number never breaks the scheduler settings (row 252)
summary: A stored 1e999 or NaN raised OverflowError past every except in the scheduler settings reader, so one damaged field made every read fail, and a save carrying one answered 500. Reading now gives the field's default (a non-finite language weight is dropped), saving refuses it by name, and the same int(float()) shape is closed in the sources CSV import and the storage-guard size variables.
